name: Stupid Horny Ponies
source:
It's no secret that ponies are stupid, or horny, or mildly insane. However, as the last of the deer, and with a big heart, you feel like you should help somehow.

You take the role of Snowleaf, the last of the deer. You and your sister Kookie are running late for Princess Yoyo's ceremony, and need to hurry up and get there. Too bad everything is just so horny. It's going to be a real challenge getting there on time like this.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/stupid-horny-ponies]Itch.io[/url]]
